title: The Door in the Hydrangea Wall

dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: exasperated

dialogue.text: Her loafer skids on the wet slope beside the shrine path.
At dawn, she had taken the shortcut behind the old hydrangea wall to save five minutes.
Instead, her sleeve brushed a bronze ring set into the mossy stone.
The wall opened like water.
I just needed a shortcut...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Now she stands before a doorway of green light, the street behind her gone silent.
Beyond it stretches a road of blue glass through red-gold grass, under a sky washed in violet.
If I go back now... where is back?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Don't step off the glass.
A boy about her age sits atop a broken milepost, silver-threaded cloak over one shoulder.
S-sorry. I didn't mean to come here.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Nobody means to, first time. The gate snagged you.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: I have entrance assembly. Or... first-term assembly.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: Then you're very lost.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: He hops down and offers her a hand. She hesitates, then takes it.
His fingers are warm. The road hums faintly beneath their shoes.
Can I get home quickly?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: If the Bell Tower is still answering, yes.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: They hurry along the glass road. On either side, lilies the size of umbrellas turn their luminous faces toward them.
Aoi's breathing slowly steadies. The fear loosens, just enough for wonder to slip in.
It's... pretty.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: That's how it tricks people.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: Ahead, a white tower rises from a lake hanging upside down in the sky.
Then the road shudders.
Stop.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: A crack runs through the blue glass. Below it, darkness flickers with distant stars.
It's breaking?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: Because the gate is closing. Run.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: She runs.
Her school bag pounds against her side. Wind full of gold sparks tears at her ribbon.
I can't... I'm not good at this...
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: holding_back_tears

dialogue.text: You're doing fine. Don't look down.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: The tower bells ring once. The sound is bright as sunlight on metal.
At the final span, Aoi falters. One loafer slides over a widening seam.
Ah—!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprised

dialogue.text: Ren catches her wrist and pulls hard. For a moment, she sees the star-dark below and her own frightened face trembling in it.
Aoi. Look at me.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: She does. His voice is steady, almost gentle.
...Okay.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: Together they leap through the tower's bronze arch just as the road breaks apart behind them like shattered ice.
On the other side stands a narrow wooden door painted with faded peonies.
This opens near where you entered. Once you cross, it may forget you.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: May?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: This world keeps what notices it.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: Her fingers tighten around her bag strap.
Then... thank you. For noticing me.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: Ren blinks, surprised, then smiles with only one corner of his mouth.
Go. And don't take shortcuts through sleeping shrines.
dialogue.speaker: Ren

dialogue.text: I won't. Probably.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: slightly_happy_faint_smile

dialogue.text: She opens the peony door.
Morning noise rushes back in — bicycle bells, crows, far-off announcements from the school gate.
Aoi stumbles out beside the hydrangea wall, knees shaking, only one street from school.
I'm... still late.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: She looks back once. The bronze ring is just an old iron hook in the stone.
But caught in her sleeve is a single thread of silver, shining faintly in the ordinary sun.
So it wasn't a dream.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: uneasy_confused

dialogue.text: She presses the thread into her palm, takes a quiet breath, and starts running again.
